insecure.title: Ghostly needs https
insecure.body: The browser only gives Ghostly its cryptography and locks on a secure address. Open the POM over https to use it.
state.unreachable: The Ghostly plugin is not answering
stage.waiting.body: The plugin starts as soon as the node hands it its context.
stage.installing.body: The first start downloads Node.js and builds the latest Ghostly release, its CLI and its web app, from the original repository. It takes a few minutes.
stage.starting.body: This node's Ghostly member is coming online.
stage.joining.body: The principal of the network holds the group; this node asks it for the link through the network's signed channel.
stage.error.body: The plugin tries again by itself.
install.build: Build the Ghostly CLI and web app
